lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆地在走廊走。
lines.en: I waddle down the hallway.
My balloon bobs along with me.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像上了发条。
lines.en: I sway each step, wound up like a toy.

lines.zh: 我的塑料脚踩得地板响。
lines.en: My plastic feet clack on the floor.
I hug my balloon and shuffle along.

lines.zh: 我从游戏机那边走过来。
lines.en: I come from the arcade machines.
My joints whine as I move.
I scuff forward with my head low.

lines.zh: 我的红蓝衣服在灯下很亮。
lines.en: My red and blue suit shines under the lights.
I walk around a table.
I am not fast, but I will not stop.

lines.zh: 我的塑料脸上还挂着笑。
lines.en: My plastic face keeps its grin.
I stand with a balloon over my head.
I tilt my head and keep smiling.
I hold my balloon and do not move.

lines.zh: 我像被摆在那里很久了。
lines.en: I look like I was set here long ago.
My joints give a small creak.
I wait by the arcade machine.
My smile has not changed.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把气球换到另一只手。
lines.en: I slowly move the balloon to my other hand.

lines.zh: 我在门边站着，提着气球。
lines.en: I stand by the door, holding my balloon.
My smile never stops.
I look at you with big eyes.
My balloon drifts toward you.
I tilt my head, politely.
You are standing under my light.
I lift the balloon at you.
My plastic fingers move.
I make no sound; I only look.
My plastic shell cracks.
I wobble worse than usual.
My smile does not go away.
One joint cracks.
My arm hangs crooked.
There is static in my circuits.
My head turns slower.
I stare at you without changing expression.
I reach for the balloon.
I push the thing aside.
A balloon is what I want.
I tilt my head as it floats off.

lines.zh: 我的手指在上面点了点。
lines.en: My finger taps it.
I lift it and let it float.

lines.zh: 我用塑料牙齿笑了一下。
lines.en: I grin with plastic teeth.
I follow it two steps.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我晃得很厉害。
lines.en: You bump me and I wobble badly.

lines.zh: 我几乎没被打动，只是摇。
lines.en: I barely budge, only sway.
My balloon is knocked away.
I reach to catch it.
We make a plastic clack.
My head tilts and settles.

lines.zh: 你被我的硬壳顶得退了。
lines.en: My hard shell pushes you back.
I wobble and steady.
My smile does not change.
The balloon bounces twice.
Two animatronics stand face to face.
Our balloons bump together.
We tilt our heads together.
My smile is the same as its.
We stare without moving.
Our joints creak together.
I hand it my balloon.
It raises a hand; so do I.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上重叠。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap on the wall.
We turn toward the door together.
I bend and pick up the balloon.
I pinch it with plastic fingers.
I hug the thing to my chest.
I grip it and do not let go.
I shake it and it rattles.
I hold it and keep smiling.
I raise it overhead.
I hug it and shuffle two steps.
I turn my head all the way.
I stop smiling and only look.
My balloon slips up and away.
I take one step at you.
My arm comes up.
Something in my circuits clicks.
I know you entered this building.
The arcade lights go out.
I start walking your way.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了一下，气球也飘了。
lines.en: My eyes flickered, and a balloon drifted up.
My smile returns.

lines.zh: 我的气球在我身后抖了一下。
lines.en: My balloon wobbles behind me.
You are the only one at the hall's end.
I no longer wait for you to approach.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声改变了节奏。
lines.en: My footsteps change rhythm.
I follow you down the corridor.
You look back; I am in the doorway.
I close in, swaying step by step.

lines.zh: 我的气球卡在天花板上。
lines.en: My balloon is stuck on the ceiling.
I wait at the turn.
My smile never changes.
You run; your footsteps are loud.
I slowly push the door open.
I stop under your light.
You hide in the locker; I know.
My plastic fingers scrape the wall.
I count how many doors you have left.

lines.zh: 我一直没有离开这一层。
lines.en: I have never left this floor.
I move when the lights flicker.
Did you hear the joints creak?
I am blocking the whole corridor.
You have backed to the end.
I am at your side, still smiling.
The door handle is slowly turning.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我全记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized every footstep of yours.
I slam a fist down on your shoulder.
My backhand slaps your face.
I throw my whole body at you.
My plastic fingers claw down.
The balloon sways over my head.

lines.zh: 我几乎没有被你的格挡推开。
lines.en: Your block barely moves me.
You are knocked into the wall.
My grin widens slightly.
I kick your knee out.
Your armor rings from the blow.
I sway and come back at you.
My hand stops in front of you.
That blow carries my weight.
You back off; I step in again.
After the blow I am still smiling.
I swat your arm from the side.
I press onto you, heavy.
I strike and retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 你一推，我晃了一下才回来。
lines.en: You shove and I wobble before returning.

lines.zh: 游戏机旁的灯亮了一下。
lines.en: The lights by the arcade flicker on.
I stand at the end of the corridor.
An animatronic appears in the doorway.
The balloon floats into the room first.
I step slowly out of the dark.
The lights here come on.
You hear plastic footsteps.
I begin to exist, smiling.
My shadow climbs the wall first.
I stand among the arcade machines.
My face shows in the door glass.
The air conditioning stops.

lines.zh: 火烤化了我衣服的一角。
lines.en: Fire melts a corner of my suit.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，壳裂了一道。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my shell cracks.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的关节，我动不了。
lines.en: Water fills my joints and I lock up.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，气球炸了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the balloon pops.
An arrow sticks in my plastic face.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我忘了下一步。
lines.en: That force makes me forget the next step.
Hunger makes my joints loose.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，线路滋滋响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my wiring fizzes.
The floor is gone; I fall.
